name: Alvin
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Alvin, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Alvin, TX: Home for the Holidays on December 4 and 5, 2026, with a play, snow hill, Santa pictures and a Light Parade.
lede: Alvin does Christmas through one city weekend, Home for the Holidays, run by Alvin Parks and Recreation at National Oak Park and along the Light Parade route.
celebrates: The City of Alvin's Parks and Recreation Department organizes Home for the Holidays each December. In 2026 it runs on Friday, December 4, and Saturday, December 5. Friday brings a gingerbread house contest at the Alvin Historic Depot Centre and a play by the Alvin Theatre Department at National Oak Park. Saturday has a Christmas festival with food trucks, bounce houses, inflatable slides and a snow hill, free pictures with Santa and a Light Parade. The city's news post is the place to find every time, and it links to registration for vendors and parade entries.
lastyear: We did not find a city recap or local news story about Home for the Holidays 2025, so this page does not describe last year's event. What we can confirm is the 2026 plan: the City of Alvin posted its schedule on November 16, 2026, with a gingerbread contest and a play on Friday, December 4, and a festival, free Santa pictures and the Light Parade on Saturday, December 5. Check the city's news page for any later changes.
facts: Alvin's holiday play is written fresh each year by the Alvin Theatre Department. This year's play is a brand-new story about the community and the values of kindness and goodwill, created by artists of all ages and skill levels over several weeks, according to the city. The gingerbread house contest is held at the Alvin Historic Depot Centre, 200 Depot Centre Blvd., for teams of two, and the city says registration is now full with a waitlist. Parade entries and festival vendors register through the city's recreation catalog.
trains: Alvin's Historic Depot Centre, 200 Depot Centre Blvd., hosts the gingerbread house contest on December 4, a nod to the town's rail history that we could confirm only as a venue. The closest Christmas train rides we found are The Polar Express at the Galveston Railroad Museum and the kiddie train at Moody Gardens' Holiday in the Gardens, both on our Galveston page.

traditions: A two day city celebration on the first weekend of December.
The Alvin Theatre Department performs a new play about kindness and goodwill.
The city lists pictures with Santa at 4 pm on Saturday as free.
A parade from 6 to 7 pm that starts and ends at the Stanton's Shopping Center parking lot.
The festival at National Oak Park includes a snow hill and inflatable slides.
kidfact: Alvin's Christmas weekend has a snow hill in Texas, and kids can slide on it at the festival at National Oak Park.

intro_html:

The magic runs from December 4 (Productions in the Park) through December 5, with the Home for the Holidays Christmas Festival and the Light Parade on December 5. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
